question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who is shy and spends time alone rather than being with others
solution:
The correct answer is "introvert".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One-word replacements** are used to simplify complex sentences by replacing them with a single word. With the **phrase** replaced, the meaning is unchanged, but the sentence is now shorter.
 
• An **introvert** is a person who possesses traits associated with the introverted personality type, meaning they prefer to pay attention to their own **inner thoughts and ideas** as opposed to what is happening around them.
 
 
• **Example:** Ram is an **introvert **person.
 
 
 
• The **introvert **has the same meaning as the given question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's check the meanings of the other words.

 
• A person who is an **egoist **is one **who is focused with their own interests**.
 
• **Extraverted** characteristics include being **talkative, active, forceful, and outgoing**.
 
• A guy who has dedicated his life to **religion** typically gives up some aspects of daily life in the process and is called a **monk**.
 
• These words are not matching with the given question.
